title: PublicFoundingHostOfferDocument
description: Public projection of one city's founding-host offer, at publicFoundingHostOffers/{marketId}, for the website's "[N] of 50 places left" strip. Rewritten in the same transaction as every owner change and every taken place, so placesLeft never runs ahead of the private counter. Holds counts only: no organizer, owner or staff identities. Anyone may read it; clients never write it. status is computed at write time, so a reader must also treat endsAtMillis at or before now as closed. An absent document means the city has no offer and the strip stays hidden.
x-owner: adminManageFoundingHostOffers and the founding place grant (functions/src/foundingHosts)

citySlug.description: The market's website slug, as in contracts/catalogs/markets.json.

status.description: open while places are left before the deadline; soldOut when none are left; closed once the deadline passed at the last write.
